verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own escalation policies define who is alerted and in what order, "continuing until the incident is acknowledged." The docs show a delay-based step: the on-call person is paged first, and after an unacknowledged interval (e.g. 3 minutes) the alert escalates to the whole team as fallback responders. Complex rules can also key on time, team availability and incident origin. However, explicit repeat rounds (looping the policy) are not documented, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repeat/loop rounds, detailed multi-step configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
